description: This file contains functions related to system configuration and management on a Broadcom-based OpenWRT system, including reading UBI metadata, setting environment configs, verifying root filesystem data, and managing firmware states.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a specified file pointer at a given offset and returns the hexadecimal representation of these bytes in little-endian order.

methods.name: bcm4908_pkgtb_setup_env_config
methods.description: Sets up environment configuration for accessing UBI volume metadata, by reading size information and writing configuration data to /tmp/env.config.

methods.name: bcm4908_committed_image_seq
methods.description: Retrieves the committed image sequence number from UBI metadata, using environment configuration and fw_printenv to extract information.

methods.name: bcm4908_verify_rootfs_data
methods.description: Ensures that the 'rootfs_data' UBI volume matches the current firmware image by mounting, verifying, and optionally wiping and reassigning the volume.
